time.meaning: Separate retained illustrative progress per succession type. Select one side before playback; durations are not ecological years.

science.scope: A schematic route under climate suitable for forest establishment, access to propagules and absence of renewed severe disturbance. Not a universal, inevitable or fixed-duration route.
science.primary: Bare rock with no developed soil; lichen establishment; moss; herbs; shrubs and saplings; tree-dominated forest with understory. Weathering, organic inputs and colonization overlap.
science.secondary: Postfire site retains soil and some viable seeds or underground organs. Annual herbs, perennial herbs, establishing shrubs, thickets and saplings, forest. Some deadwood remains.
science.transition: Layer weights represent illustrative dominance and cover, not measured abundance or calibrated soil depth. Roots, seed bank and soil section are schematic, not to scale.
science.coexistence: Earlier functional groups can persist. Herbs, shrubs and trees overlap; later stages do not wipe out all earlier organisms.
science.animation: Each side has a deterministic retained clock. Selecting a type pauses playback and changes only the controlled timeline. All plants and animals use their own side clock.
